title: Content Editor – Newsletters (Remote)
description:
Overview

Content Editor – Newsletters (Remote) at Mode Mobile. Mode Mobile operates a rapidly growing newsletter media portfolio reaching 8 million+ active subscriptions across multiple high-performing titles. Our newsletters span Finance, Crypto, and Consumer segments, combining original insights, curated news, and smart monetization to deliver high-value, high-impact content to millions of engaged readers every week.

The Role

We’re seeking a Content Editor to take creative and editorial ownership of our newsletter portfolio. You’ll refine tone, tighten storytelling, and ensure each issue delivers clarity, personality, and consistency. This is a player-coach role where you will own content/writing for one of our flagship newsletters each week while also managing and elevating the work of our other writers. You will help scale the current team by implementing best-in-class editing processes and leveraging AI-powered tools to enhance efficiency and quality. This role is ideal for a seasoned editor who knows how to turn good writing into great performance content that both informs and converts. You should thrive at the intersection of journalism, marketing, and growth.

Who You Are and What You’ll Do

  • Review and edit daily, weekly, and special-edition newsletters across Finance, Crypto, and Consumer verticals.
  • Write and lead 1–2 core newsletters (Finance, Crypto, or Consumer) to set the standard for tone, depth, and quality.
  • Use tools and AI platforms to streamline content production and optimize quality.
  • Enhance subject lines, headlines, and formatting to improve overall narrative flow and boost engagement.
  • Collaborate with Growth, Analytics, and Design teams to align content with audience data and performance goals.
  • Maintain brand voice consistency across titles while adapting tone for each vertical.
  • Provide feedback and editorial guidance to contributors.
  • Coordinate with the sales team to integrate sponsored or affiliate content seamlessly.
  • Audit and refine newsletter templates for readability, UX, and brand alignment (design resources will be provided).
  • Contribute to editorial testing and experimentation (A/B testing subject lines, formats, or CTAs).
  • Help develop and document editorial style guides, tone frameworks, and content workflows.

What You Bring to the Team

  • 5+ years of experience editing newsletters or digital publications (newsletter experience required; media startup or high-volume environment a plus).
  • Deep familiarity with email content formats and audience engagement metrics (open rates, CTR, conversions, retention).
  • Strong editorial judgment and ability to synthesize complex topics into engaging, actionable, and concise copy.
  • Proven ability to manage deadlines and edit multiple newsletters simultaneously.
  • Experience in finance, crypto, or consumer media/journalism is strongly preferred.
  • Comfortable collaborating in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Proficiency with AI-based editing, grammar, or analytics tools (e.g., Grammarly, ChatGPT, Jasper).
  • Nice to Have
  • Familiarity with Beehiiv, Substack, ConvertKit, HubSpot, or similar ESPs.
  • Understanding of affiliate, sponsorship, or performance-based monetization.
  • Experience leading or mentoring a small editorial team or building editorial operations.
  • Basic understanding of SEO, audience segmentation, or retention strategy.

Alignment with Our Core Values

  • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrate trustworthiness and self-discipline, and communicate effectively.
  • Action-driven: You identify what is most important, execute promptly, and drive impact.
  • Caring: You care about the team, mission, and quality of work, fostering a positive environment.
  • Curious: You seek to understand the why, learn continuously, and improve.
  • Thorough: You deliver thoughtful, accurate, and complete work with attention to detail.

Why Join Mode Mobile

  • Reach millions of engaged readers daily and influence their experience.
  • Work with a fast-growing, data-driven media team backed by strong data and monetization performance.
  • Shape the editorial voice and standards of a major newsletter network.
  • 100% remote work in a collaborative culture.
  • Growth-minded environment where your editorial impact is measurable.

Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to Guide Us
  • Assume Positive Intent
  • Agree to Disagree & Commit
  • Set New Precedents
  • Accomplish More with Less
  • Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
  • Speak Up
  • Be Resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 Rule

What We Are Offering

  • 100% remote-first, global company.
  • Competitive compensation package and generous perks & benefits.
  • Participation in the Company’s equity plan (for full-time team members).
  • Individual bonuses in accordance with the Company Bonus Program.
  • Open PTO, generous holidays, and wellness days for full-time team members.

EEO Statement : Mode Mobile is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Controller
description:
Overview

Job Title: Controller

Type: Full-time, Remote

Working Hours: Central Time Zone (CST)

Salary: 3,000 – 4,000 USD/month (based on assessment)

Location: Latin America

About The Company

Our client is a fast-growing retail company operating 30+ locations across the U.S., with plans to add multiple new locations annually. The business is scaling rapidly, backed by strong leadership and a modern approach to operations. They’re looking for a hands-on, experienced Controller to build structure, improve processes, and bring financial rigor to the company’s next stage of growth.

About The Role

The Financial Controller will oversee all accounting operations, manage a small bookkeeping team, and own the monthly close and reporting process. This is a role for a seasoned professional who thrives in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment — someone who can roll up their sleeves, streamline processes, and provide accurate, timely insights to leadership.

You’ll collaborate closely with the CFO and the executive team to strengthen financial systems, implement automation, and support budgeting and forecasting. The ideal candidate is CPA-qualified, process-driven, and experienced in leading accounting operations for a multi-unit or retail-based business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including reconciliations, journal entries, month-end, and year-end close.
  • Manage and mentor a team of bookkeepers, ensuring accuracy and accountability.
  • Prepare consolidated financial statements and maintain the general ledger across multiple entities.
  • Oversee cash reconciliations, accounts payable, and accounts receivable functions.
  • Develop and improve accounting policies, processes, and internal controls, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency.
  • Leverage accounting software (ideally Xero) to maintain accurate books and streamline reporting.
  • Utilize reporting tools like Fathom (or similar) to produce management reports and dashboards.
  • Partner with the CFO and P&L owners to support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Produce accurate, timely financial and management reports to support decision-making.
  • Support external auditors during audits and ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP. Collaborate cross-functionally with operations and leadership to maintain financial visibility across all laundromat locations.

Qualifications

  • CPA required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2+ years in a Controller or similar leadership role
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and multi-entity accounting
  • Proven experience managing bookkeeping or accounting staff, ideally in an offshore or remote setup
  • Hands-on experience with monthly close, reconciliations, and reporting
  • Tools: Xero and Fathom (or similar) preferred
  • Skilled in identifying and implementing process improvements or automation tools
  • Experience supporting budgeting and forecasting (FP&A) is a strong plus
  • Audit experience preferred (not required)
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to collaborate effectively with executives and team members across time zones
  • Experience in retail, multi-location, or franchise-style businesses preferred
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Revenue Manager - Remote
description:
Compensation Type: Yearly – Highgate Hotels

Highgate is a premier real estate investment and hospitality management company widely recognized as an innovator in the industry. Highgate is the dominant player in U.S. gateway markets including New York, Boston, Miami, San Francisco and Honolulu, with a rapidly expanding presence in Europe, Latin America, and the Caribbean. Highgate’s portfolio of global properties represents an aggregate asset value exceeding $20B and generates over $5B in cumulative revenues. The company provides expert guidance through all stages of the hospitality property cycle, from planning and development through recapitalization or disposition. Highgate also has the creativity and bandwidth to develop bespoke hotel brands and utilizes industry‑leading proprietary revenue management tools that identify and predict evolving market dynamics to drive out performance and maximize asset value. With an executive team consisting of some of the industry’s most experienced hotel management leaders, the company is a trusted partner for top ownership groups and major hotel brands. Highgate maintains corporate offices in London, New York, Dallas, and Seattle.

Location Overview

The Revenue Manager is responsible for identifying and maximizing all potential revenue opportunities for the hotel. In today’s lodging environment, understanding channel and yield management is critical for maximizing revenues. The Revenue Manager is responsible for formulating long and short‑term Revenue Management strategies and for overseeing their successful execution towards the advancement of RevPAR market share. This includes the analysis of revenue potential generated by the transient and group market segments as well as the market segmentation within transient and group. This is a remote position.

Responsibilities

  • Establish hotel pricing levels in all segments.
  • Responsible for the daily room inventory management process and daily pricing process.
  • Monitor competitor rates, positioning, strategies and data; maintain understanding of the dynamics of the local market and demand generators and present appropriate action plans to management.
  • Monitor and communicate fluctuations in occupancy to operational departments so they can effectively manage staffing requirements and increase efficiency.
  • Analyze local events and activities and project the effect of opportunities they create.
  • Understand the macro and micro-economic variables affecting supply and demand in the local marketplace, and use this knowledge to create accurate operational and financial room revenue forecasts.
  • Perform unconstrained demand analysis to determine optimal business mix.
  • Responsible for all short and long term forecasts including Weekly Forecasts, Forecasts, In the month forecasts, and Full year forecasts.
  • Oversee process for evaluating all opportunities for contracted business (group, wholesale, corporate negotiated, etc.) presented through the Sales department. Ensure that process enables high speed of response while maximizing profits.
  • Responsible for the maintenance of any software programs which contribute to the management of rooms revenue, including the CRS, RMS, PMS and Sales & Catering system.
  • Monitor RevPAR index on STR report and provide critical analysis of performance on weekly and monthly basis.
  • Prepare annual Rooms revenue budget.
  • Chair weekly Revenue Strategy meetings in order to formulate and disseminate strategies and tactics. Ensure that prior decisions are re-visited in this forum in order to evaluate their effectiveness and promote learning.
  • Prepare and present quarterly presentations to ownership.
  • Ensure all distribution channels have correct content and pricing.
  • Develop and maintain a close relationship with the market manager of Third Party Intermediaries to maximize the opportunities with these channels.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with other market revenue managers and Directors of Revenue to create a network of peers in your community
  • Coordinate survey activities involving marketing and service opportunities to further enhance revenue potential.
  • Actively develop all subordinates, ensuring that they have opportunities to grow their Revenue Management and leadership skill base through personal attention, internal/external training and participation in industry events.
  • Responsible for Internet Marketing such as pay per click campaigns, e-mail blasts, GDS advertising, etc.
  • Establish and communicate sales strategy for day, week, month and rolling 12 months.
  • Communicate any strategy changes or update any calendars for the sales team to use.
  • Analyze prior night successes: Did the hotel sell out? Were the right decisions made for overselling? Address the opportunities in Highgate Hotel Business Review (HHBR) morning meeting.
  • Place test calls to Central Reservation Office (CRO) and property to ensure accuracy of rate quoting, restrictions and selling approach.
  • Manage and communicate group cut off dates. Run a group rooms control log (GRC) as well as pick up report from Property Management System (PMS) for 90 days. Verify pick up to actual block, cut off date, and whether or not you should extend, etc.
  • Update the Daily Market Segment Analysis (DMSA). Ensure accuracy from the daily Flash Report. Review actual performance versus Potential performance.
  • Complete all required month end reports with detailed analysis. If necessary, complete action plans for the property to follow to create additional production/revenue.
  • Review Hotelligence reports for trends, booking windows and sources of business as well as rates compared to competition.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years experience in the Revenue Management field as manager or senior analyst
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Hotel or Hospitality Management or closely related field
  • In-Depth knowledge of all industry reports such as STR, Hotelligence, Market Vision, etc.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point
  • Ability to work quickly in a high-pressure & high stress environment
  • Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Exceptional with details and follow up
  • Flexible and long hours sometimes required.
  • Maintain a warm and friendly demeanor at all times.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate both verbally and written, with all level of employees and guests in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service oriented manner.
  • Must be effective at listening to, understanding, and clarifying concerns raised by employees and guests.
  • Must be able to multitask and prioritize departmental functions to meet deadlines.
  • Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service-oriented manner.
  • Attend all hotel required meetings and trainings.
  • Participate in M.O.D. coverage as required.
  • Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Highgate Hotel Standards, as required by scheduling, which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
  • Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include wearing nametags.
  • Comply with Highgate Hotel Standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.
  • Maximize efforts towards productivity, identify problem areas and assist in implementing solutions.
  • Must be effective in handling problems, including anticipating, preventing, identifying and solving problems as necessary.
  • Must be able to understand and evaluate complex information, data, etc. from various sources to meet appropriate objectives.
  • Must be able to maintain confidentiality of information.
  • Perform other duties as requested by management

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

We’re looking for a UX Designer who’s excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative, especially in games inspired by classic and modern JRPGs. As a UX Designer on our team, you’ll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat, and exploration.   • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game genre-aware solutions
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game

Qualifications

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity)
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics
  • A player-first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices
  • Excellent communication skills
  • You can explain your reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles

Bonus Points

LEDN is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise.

This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.

You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.

You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.

You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.

You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)

You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.

Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.

You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.

You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • Knowledge of working with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience to people in multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • Writing skills in tickets, email or Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, and concise writing style; sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • Knowledge of PGP and commitment to security.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • Ability to troubleshoot according to OSI model layers methodically.
  • Self‑management and ability to scope projects, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills.
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (experience with these environments). No certifications required.
  • Experience using tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to reduce effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.

Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.

Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.

Have worked in a remote environment before.

Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

Competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.

Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

A career that provides you with purpose in your job.

We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Staff Analytics Engineering Lead | Data Delivery

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Analytics Engineering Lead to our Data Delivery team in Brazil. This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

As a Staff Analytics Engineer Lead in the Data Delivery team, you'll play a critical role in scaling our data capabilities and driving our ambitious Data Democratization movement. You won't just help build pipelines; you'll be a key driver in shaping how we build, govern, and distribute data across a microservice-driven architecture. We own the data exploration layers, transforming raw data into structured, easy-to-consume, domain-driven datasets that power corporate analytics, reverse ETL, and self-service exploration across the company.

Your work will directly influence the success of our data-driven culture by:

  • Leading key initiatives for the Data Delivery team, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring alignment between technical execution and company-wide data strategy.
  • Driving the Shift Left movement by collaboratively defining the patterns, standards, and tools that enable microservice teams (Data Producers) to expose high-quality, consumable data with robust data contracts.
  • Architecting and championing robust data models within our data warehouse (Medallion Architecture) ensuring data consistency and adherence to our central data concepts, significantly enhancing the reliability of company-wide reporting and analysis.
  • Empowering the distributed Data Chapter (embedded analysts) by providing them with the highest-quality, most discoverable datasets necessary for their business and product insights.

YOUR IMPACT

Initiative & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage cross-functional data initiatives, establishing clear roadmaps, managing dependencies, and communicating progress and risks to senior stakeholders across the Business Units and Product Tech Unit.
  • Act as a technical product owner for data assets within your assigned domains, gathering complex requirements from the Global Analytics, Product and Business teams, translating them into actionable data delivery plans.
  • Collaborate closely with the Data Platform and Data Solutions teams to ensure the transformation and tooling capabilities (e.g., Trino, Airflow, OpenMetadata) align with our delivery needs.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness

Technical Design & Delivery

  • Design and maintain scalable, high-integrity data models (e.g., dimensional, facts, and aggregated marts) within our domain-driven data warehouse that are optimized for both Trino performance and self-service analytics.
  • Develop robust, test-driven ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and SQL in our Airflow environment to transform raw, distributed microservice data into gold-standard domain datasets.
  • Champion and enforce our data governance practices, ensuring data models and transformations enforce correspondence with formal company-wide data concepts and quality standards.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance on best practices in data modeling and pipeline development to other engineers in the Data Delivery team.

WHO YOU ARE

You're an experienced Data and/or Analytics Engineer with a proven track record of moving beyond coding to manage complex data projects and influence technical direction.

  • You have successfully led and delivered large-scale data and analytics engineering initiatives in a distributed data environment.
  • You possess a deep and practical understanding of data modeling principles (dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, domain-driven design, etc.) and can design structures that balance flexibility, consistency, and query performance.
  • You are a highly effective communicator, able to engage engineering, product, and senior management stakeholders to align on requirements, contracts, and data solutions.
  • You are comfortable with the challenges of a hub-and-spoke operating model , capable of advocating for central consistency while supporting distributed data ownership.
  • Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation and pipeline construction.
  • Proven expertise in designing and optimizing Data Warehouse or Lakehouse data models.
  • Strong understanding of distributed query engines (e.g., Trino/Presto ) and query optimization techniques.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools like Airflow or similar platforms.
  • Advanced knowledge of data governance , data quality checks (e.g., Great Expectations), and ensuring semantic consistency across data domains.
  • Strong communication with both technical and business stakeholders
  • Roadmap, task management and prioritization
  • Familiarity with data cataloging and discovery tools such asOpenMetadata .
  • Previous experience with, or involvement in, an organizational transformation towards aShift Left or Data Mesh approach will accelerate success.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with SQL and Python for data transformation and pipeline construction are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Robotics Specialist Technician

The Robotics Specialist Technician will be the technical pillar for supporting, analyzing, and developing applications with our service robots. This position requires an analytical professional with strong communication skills and the availability to act as the main technical interlocutor, ensuring maximum efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct detailed research and analysis of defects, identifying root causes in collaboration with the engineering team.
  • Provide remote technical support and, when necessary, on-site support for demonstrations, installations, and corrective and preventive maintenance.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for matters related to the robot line, negotiating and aligning expectations.
  • Consolidate and interpret operational data from the robots, using tools such as spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) to generate performance reports, incidents, and metrics.
  • Apply analytical and critical thinking to the collected data to propose improvements to products and processes.
  • Develop small applications and customizations for service robots, focusing on cleaning and delivery, optimizing functionality and interface.
  • Test and validate new applications and software updates in controlled and customer environments.
  • Possess excellent English communication skills for writing and reading manuals as technical documentation, and exchanging emails with suppliers and headquarters.
  • Good in meetings with customers, building rapport.
  • Deal with manufacturers and suppliers during unconventional hours, ensuring operational continuity.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Technical Degree or ongoing Higher Education in Mechatronics, Electronics, Automation, or related fields.
  • Solid knowledge in robotics, including operating principles, sensors, actuators, and control systems.
  • Familiar with AI Tools (Gemini, DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Generative AI).
  • Proven experience with spreadsheet tools for data consolidation, report generation, and analysis.
  • English proficiency for technical reading, writing, and business speaking.
  • Availability for travel and customer visits (≈80% of the time), plus flexibility to work unconventional hours for support and contact with manufacturers. Operates under the Time Bank (Banco de Horas) system.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills for solving complex problems.
  • Valid National Driver's License (category B).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience with service robots, especially in cleaning and delivery applications.
  • Basic knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, C++).
  • Experience with remote and on-site technical customer support.
  • Technical documentation writing skills.

Desired Behavioral Competencies

  • Proactivity and autonomy.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication.
  • Resilience and ability to work under pressure.
  • Inquisitive and problem‑solving oriented mind.
  • Organization and attention to detail.
  • Strong critical and analytical thinking skills.
  • Works well as part of a team.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Fixed Income Interest Rate QA Specialist to join our team and ensure the delivery of functional test automations. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in both domain and QA technical aspects, with a focus on designing and executing manual and automated tests to streamline the development/regression life cycle in Swaps, Bonds, CDS platforms. Working with QAs, DEVs, BAs and Product Owners you will help drive best automation and manual testing practices in the project.

Responsibilities

  • Perform functional, non-functional, and regression testing for fixed income interest rate electronic trading platforms (Swaps, Bonds, CDS).
  • Possess domain expertise on fixed income instruments including interest rate swaps, futures and bonds.
  • Create reusable, maintainable test scripts for both UI and API testing within the existing or new frameworks.
  • Develop and execute API test cases to validate backend services, ensuring seamless integration with the front end component.
  • Create and manage test cases in Xray integrated with Jira, ensuring traceability to requirements and coverage for both UI and API layers.
  • Execute automated tests across multiple currencies and environments.
  • Sync automated test results back to Xray, generating detailed reports.
  • Integrate automation scripts into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing.
  • Identify, document, and track defects in Jira while collaborating with developers for resolution.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and Scrum process.
  • Ensure comprehensive test coverage for functional, regression, API testing, and integration testing.
  • Regularly review test execution results and coverage reports in Xray/Jira to ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Learn quickly the existing test framework and tests.
  • Experience with Xray API integration from scratch to automatically upload test results to Jira after execution.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools and version control systems (Git).
  • Strong hands-on experience with QA testing for Investment Banking electronic trading platforms.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and experience using Jira.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Pro-active planning and individual contribution.

This role is ideal for candidates passionate about Fixed Income eTrading platform tests automation, quality assurance and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will be part of an elite Agile team operating globally.

Experience & Technical Skills

  • Experience: 7+ years
  • Technical skill sets: Expert QA manual and automation testing experience with Selenium, Java, Cucumber, SikuliX, Maven, Git, Playwright, API, Xray, Jira

Focusing on offshore and onshore logistics operations, this position will plan, coordinate, and execute the movement of materials, equipment, and personnel. Responsibilities

About the Role

At Innodata, we\'re working with the world\'s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We\'re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts. We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist with a Master\'s or PhD in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field to join our cutting-edge AI team. In this role, you will contribute to the development, training, and fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs) by applying statistical methods, data analysis, and model evaluation techniques. Your expertise will directly impact the accuracy, performance, and robustness of advanced AI systems deployed for real-world applications.

  • Hands-on experience with large-scale datasets, data cleaning, feature engineering, and statistical analysis tools.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Julia, including libraries like pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, or statsmodels.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and understanding of LLM architectures (transformers, attention mechanisms).
  • Experience with annotation tools and data labeling processes is a plus.

Atuamos em projetos em mais de 14 países, entre eles Alemanha, Reino Unido, Japão, Suécia, Coreia do Sul, Moçambique, Guatemala, Argentina, Chile e Peru.

Responsabilidades

O Product Owner é responsável por maximizar o valor do produto resultante do trabalho da equipe de desenvolvimento. Esta função envolve colaborar com o Gerente de Produto, os Proprietários de Negócio e as equipes de desenvolvimento para traduzir a visão e a estratégia de alto nível em histórias de usuário e tarefas acionáveis. O Product Owner garante que a equipe entenda os requisitos do produto e trabalhe para entregar incrementos de alta qualidade que atendam às necessidades do negócio.

Os Product Owners (POs) podem ser chamados de TPOs quando os produtos são altamente técnicos e exigem facilitadores de tecnologia com frequência.

Principais atividades

  • Possuir e gerenciar as histórias de usuário da equipe dentro do backlog do produto, garantindo que estejam atualizadas, priorizadas e alinhadas com o roteiro do produto e a direção estratégica definida pelo Gerente de Produto.
  • Escrever histórias de usuário claras, concisas e acionáveis com critérios de aceitação bem definidos.
  • Refinar e priorizar continuamente o backlog com base no feedback das partes interessadas, no valor do negócio e nas mudanças nos requisitos.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Gerente de Produto para entender a visão, a estratégia e os objetivos do produto.
  • Interagir com as equipes de Engenharia, Arquitetos e outras partes interessadas para coletar requisitos técnicos, feedback e validar histórias.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as partes interessadas e a equipe de desenvolvimento para garantir o alinhamento.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e liderança às equipes de engenharia, garantindo que as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas com os requisitos do produto e os objetivos do negócio.

  • Assist with planning, managing, and tracking of regulatory submissions.

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in a work‑related area preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal / communication skills.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Office Applications.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently and to understand and carry out detailed instructions.
  • Ability to interact with staff from multiple departments.
  • Ability to work concurrently on projects, each with specific instructions that may differ from project to project.
  • Fluent in speaking, writing, and reading English.
  • In‑depth understanding of regulatory requirements and guidelines including FDA regulations, EMA guidelines and ICH standards. Keywords: eCTD, NDA, IND, EU CTA, MAA, EU CTR, NDS.

Join a High-Performance Startup Focused on Building the Future of AI-Driven Paid Acquisition Performance Marketing

At WKND, we’re not just another agency—we’re shaping a tech-driven future where AI-powered solutions revolutionize how brands acquire and retain customers. Relentless Pursuit of Excellence

At WKND, excellence isn’t optional—it’s our standard. We have cultivated a performance-first culture where outcomes reign supreme. Whether it takes three hours or three hundred, our goal remains the same: deliver world-class results with a tangible impact. Every team member is empowered to think critically, act decisively, and solve complex problems at scale. This is not a place for those seeking routine—it’s for those who thrive under pressure and are driven by transformative outcomes.

Innovation at Speed

We exist to outpace the speed of innovation in our industry. WKND’s work culture is defined by accountability, speed, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We don’t just meet expectations—we exceed them. By leveraging advanced AI and automation, we craft data-driven marketing strategies that deliver measurable ROI for our clients while setting new standards in acquisition and retention.

Uncompromising Standards

Our team acts with a founder’s mentality—taking full ownership of their work and upholding exceptionally high standards. Collaboration, precision, and simplicity fuel our execution. Every process we design is built to scale without unnecessary complexity, ensuring each solution is as potent as it is elegant.

Customer-Centric Mission

Our clients’ success is our driving force. We are obsessed with creating exceptional experiences that empower global DTC brands to attract, convert, and retain customers at scale. From high-performing ad campaigns and creative iterations to AI-driven marketing solutions, we’re laser-focused on delivering strategies that surpass expectations and fuel sustained growth.

Visionary Thinking

At WKND, we don’t just look at where marketing stands today—we anticipate where it’s going tomorrow. We operate with a forward-thinking mindset, exploring how AI and emerging tech will reshape both acquisition and retention strategies over the next decade. Join us in laying the foundation for the future of eCommerce growth.

This is your chance to be part of a team where excellence is non-negotiable, and rewards are directly tied to performance. If you’re ready to tackle challenges, push boundaries, and define the future of data-driven marketing, WKND is where you belong. We don’t just aim to compete—we aim to lead.

The Power of Communication

At WKND, clear, proactive communication is the backbone of our high-performance culture. We believe in staying ahead of potential issues rather than reacting after problems arise. By sharing insights, challenges, and wins early and often, we maintain transparency, solve complex problems faster, and keep our teams fully aligned. This approach fosters accountability not just within individual departments but across the entire organization—everyone owns their deliverables while working cohesively toward common objectives.

As a consultative expert , you will bridge the gap between our internal strategies and our external partners’ growth initiatives and business goals. This involves active listening —genuinely hearing and understanding each stakeholder’s perspective, then offering thoughtful recommendations that drive both short-term impact and long-term success. By practicing intentional thought partnership and close collaboration, you’ll build strong, trusting relationships that ensure our clients feel heard, supported, and set up for success. Ultimately, this culture of open dialogue and empathy elevates everyone’s contributions—enabling us to deliver world-class outcomes at speed.

Why Join WKND?

  • Build Innovative SaaS Solutions
    Contribute to developing scalable software designed for global eCommerce markets.
  • Solve Mission-Critical Challenges
    Address complex acquisition and business challenges using AI-powered tools that drive efficiency, engagement, and ROI.
  • Pace of Innovation
    Operate at the cutting edge of AI technology, where bold thinking and agility are the keys to success.
  • Performance-Based Rewards
    Benefit from a competitive compensation structure with stock options, directly aligning your growth with our company’s trajectory.
  • Relentless Pursuit of Excellence
    Collaborate with a team that values meaningful outcomes over mere effort and recognizes truly exceptional results.

Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. You’ll execute and optimize campaigns across major social platforms, ensuring they meet and exceed performance targets while aligning with broader marketing initiatives. With your strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate creative, retention, and conversion rate optimization efforts into cohesive campaigns.

This role offers a clear path to leadership – you’ll work alongside our Paid Media Manager (PMM) to accomplish key business objectives and initiatives, positioning yourself for future growth into roles like Paid Media Manager. If you’re a data-savvy, innovative marketer passionate about leveraging AI and rapid experimentation to scale DTC brands, this opportunity is your next big challenge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Paid Social Campaign Execution & Optimization: Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms (e.g., Facebook/Instagram, TikTok) to drive customer acquisition and retention. Implement audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and bidding strategies, continuously A/B testing creatives and audience approaches to maximize engagement and conversions. Ensure all campaigns align with client goals and WKND’s performance benchmarks for measurable outcomes.
  • Full-Funnel Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align paid social initiatives with broader direct-to-consumer growth strategies, ensuring a cohesive full-funnel approach from prospecting to retention. Work closely with creative, email/SMS, conversion rate optimization, SEO, and content teams to integrate campaign efforts and share insights. Ensure consistent messaging and leverage cross-channel learnings to improve marketing efficiency and customer lifetime value.
  • Data Analysis & KPI Management: Leverage advanced analytics platforms and AI-driven tools to monitor campaign performance and inform optimizations. Track and analyze key metrics – including return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing efficiency ratio (MER), click-through rate (CTR), average order value (AOV), and CAC-to-LTV ratio – adjusting budgets and strategy to exceed targets. Use data-driven insights to make timely optimizations that improve ROI and scale results.
  • Insightful Reporting & Presentations: Compile and present detailed performance reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Create visually compelling presentations for internal teams and clients, highlighting campaign results, trends, and strategic recommendations. Communicate the story behind the numbers, enabling informed decision-making and demonstrating the value of our paid social efforts.
  • Client Communication Support: Support the Paid Media Manager in delivering top-notch client service through effective communication. Participate in occasional client calls or meetings to provide updates, explain campaign performance, and answer questions with professionalism and clarity. Help maintain transparent, trusting relationships by ensuring clients understand campaign progress and value.
  • Strategic Initiative Execution: Partner with the PMM to execute key business initiatives and special projects in paid media. Translate high-level objectives into actionable campaign plans and take ownership of their successful implementation. Proactively contribute ideas and optimizations that drive business goals, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • AI-Driven Innovator: You’re passionate about leveraging AI and automation to push the limits of what's possible, always looking for ways to deliver scalable, cutting-edge solutions that drive success.
  • Tech Visionary: You thrive in environments that challenge you to innovate, embracing new technologies and harnessing them to create transformative, future-proof SaaS platforms.
  • Creative Problem Solver: You’re not afraid to think outside the box, tackling complex challenges with fresh perspectives and finding solutions that have a lasting impact.
  • Collaborative Team Player: You excel in communicating complex ideas clearly, working seamlessly across teams, and contributing to a culture of open collaboration to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Results-Oriented & Data-Driven: You’re obsessed with data, continuously interpreting metrics to relentlessly optimize campaigns and drive unparalleled ROI. You’re not just meeting targets—you’re exceeding them.
  • Platform Proficiency & Digital Mastery: You’re a wizard across paid platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, and more, with a sharp understanding of AI-driven optimization tools that push performance to new heights.
  • Proactive & Adaptable: You’re always ahead of the curve, staying on top of platform changes and anticipating challenges before they arise. You pivot with agility, turning potential obstacles into growth opportunities

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field (required) .
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience in paid social (required) , with a deep understanding of paid acquisition and media buying strategies. Proven ability to scale campaigns, manage substantial budgets, and consistently meet or exceed key performance targets.
  • Technical Skills: Highly knowledgeable in bidding and targeting automation tools; proficient in Google Analytics and other ad management/testing platforms.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent project management and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to structure complex, multi-stakeholder projects effectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills for both client-facing and internal collaboration.
  • Performance Culture: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and effective time-management.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Base Salary: Calibrated to attract top talent who thrive under high expectations.
  • Generous Stock Options: Align your success with the company’s trajectory and shared prosperity.
  • Performance-Based Bonuses: Earn additional rewards for surpassing key growth milestones and metrics.
  • Access to Advanced Development Tools & Resources: Stay on the cutting edge with the latest AI-driven marketing technologies.
  • High-Performance Culture: Be part of a team where your contributions are noticed, celebrated, and rewarded for driving real impact.
  • Healthcare & Wellness Options (available upon request): Designed to support your well-being and peace of mind.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work remotely or in-office, as long as you meet deadlines and deliver exceptional results.

Ready to Shape the Future of Paid Acquisition & Paid Social — And Revolutionize with AI?

Join WKND as a Senior Paid Social Acquisition Specialist and become a pivotal force behind high-performing, AI-enhanced campaigns for top DTC brands. You won’t just execute ads—you’ll help shape strategy, pioneer new approaches in paid social, and contribute to our bold shift toward an AI-driven SaaS model.

If you’re passionate about delivering transformative outcomes, driving exponential growth, and advancing your career in a cutting-edge environment, WKND is where you belong .
Apply now to join our high-performance team, harness AI-driven insights, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in digital marketing. Together, we’ll redefine eCommerce growth and achieve exceptional results for our clients.

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, but also passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Do

  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will:
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.
  • Ledn Working Environment — Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

We offer a pay range of $8 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. title: Information Technology - SAP Release Manager (4776-1)
description:
Overview

Job Description: An SAP Release Manager plans, coordinates, and controls the entire SAP release lifecycle, from defining release strategies and schedules to managing deployments and post-go-live support, ensuring quality, minimizing business disruption, and maintaining compliance with standards like ITIL and SOX. Key responsibilities include stakeholder communication, risk management, process governance, and continuous improvement of the release process through post-release reviews and key performance indicator (KPI) tracking.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Planning: Develop and maintain the SAP release strategy, plan, and calendar, coordinating release windows and cycles across various SAP modules and integrated applications.
  • Execution & Coordination: Manage and coordinate all release activities, ensuring timely and seamless execution by working closely with development, testing, and infrastructure teams.
  • Governance & Compliance: Implement and enforce release management processes and quality gates, ensuring adherence to standards such as ITIL, SOX, and audit requirements.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks to the release schedule, quality, and scope, and develop mitigation strategies to prevent delays or disruptions.
  • Stakeholder Management: Liaise with business stakeholders, project managers, and other relevant teams to align release activities with business priorities.
  • Communication: Act as the central point of communication, providing transparency on release plans, risks, impacts, and progress to all involved parties.
  • Post-Release Activities: Conduct post-release reviews and postmortems, track release KPIs (success rate, defect leakage), and identify lessons learned for continuous process improvement.
  • Quality Assurance: Oversee the entire release lifecycle, ensuring that all release criteria, including functionality, performance, and security requirements, are met before deployment.
  • Process Improvement: Drive initiatives to improve workflows and efficiency, developing and implementing automation tools and frameworks to streamline release processes

title: IVPP Specialist Case Manager
description:
IVPP Specialist Case Manager

Job Purpose

This position involves performing various tasks, including but not limited to, consistent follow-up on student concerns, student wellness, and student communication. The role manages student requests for extenuating circumstances, conducts housing, wellness, and hospital visits, and contacts families on an as‑needed basis related to student wellness and concerns. The incumbent typically works with a high degree of independence and uses initiative to conduct regular assignments following established policies and procedures. Additionally, the incumbent will provide advocacy services to students impacted by interpersonal violence. This position reports to the Director of Student Services within the Student Affairs Division.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts generally include administrators, faculty, students, and staff. External contacts include vendors, consultants, visitors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Address student requests and follow up or advocate for them with professors for support.
  • Respond to student requests and investigate the integrity of each request by requesting and reviewing documentation, and follow up with the appropriate actions to assist the student.
  • Conduct regular in‑person visits with students or conduct classroom visits to monitor student progress.
  • Work with students and professors to put plans in place for student success.
  • Listen to students, evaluate, and investigate the integrity of the concern(s), and adjust to improve student outcomes.
  • Record students' progress and interactions, including charting, home visits, hospital visits, family communication, and professor communication.
  • Follow up with closed cases to ensure student success.
  • Visit students who are hospitalized at Howard University Hospital.
  • Conduct wellness checks in residence halls.
  • Serve as a consultant related to health, wellness, and safety topics of interpersonal violence prevention. This function includes sexual assault and harassment, dating/domestic violence, and stalking. Programming will involve students, faculty, and staff. Programming should be evidence‑informed and campus‑specific to prevent violence.
  • Implement public‑health oriented, evidence‑informed interventions and programming to promote a campus community environment that seeks to decrease and eliminate interpersonal violence.
  • Provide advocacy services and interventions for students impacted by interpersonal violence and inform the Director of Student Services of standard updates and necessary policy and procedural adjustments that enhance the objectives of student welfare.
  • Refer students to the correct Howard University offices, including but not limited to Counseling Services, Department Chairs, and Financial Aid.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Compassionate and able to relate to different students with various needs.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to explain extreme situations to family members and professors.
  • Critical thinking and problem solving to determine the course of action for each student after assessing student concerns.
  • Flexibility to change plans if the student is not getting appropriate results.
  • Organization skills to manage several different cases at once.
  • Experience working in confidential and sensitive settings and circumstances, including supporting survivors of violence.
  • Knowledge of state, jurisdictional, and federal laws, policies, and regulations associated with interpersonal and sexual violence and support for individuals impacted (Title IX, FERPA, VAWA, etc.).
  • Computer literacy to maintain and manage case records in Maxient.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in social work or related field from an accredited college/university.
  • 2 – 4 years of experience providing student support.
  • Knowledge of standard office administrative practices and procedures.
  • Excellent communication, writing, organization, and planning skills.
  • Proficient computer skills and in‑depth knowledge of relevant software.
  • Information gathering and monitoring skills.
  • Attention to detail, meets deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to work with students in crisis.
  • Sound judgment, problem analysis, problem solving, and decision‑making skills.
  • Initiative, confidentiality, teamwork, and adaptability.

$47,000 – $52,000
