title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Join to apply for the Product Manager, Lending role at Clutch

About The Role

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track.
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turn urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems.
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence: Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills: You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly. Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch: We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you’re in the seat, bring on the prompts!

Somos quase 2.500 Spreaders, espalhados em 22 estados brasileiros através do Spread Anywhere, que nos permite trabalhar de forma 100% remota, dependendo do modelo de contrato. Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão. Aqui a diversidade e inclusão não é apenas uma palavra, mas sim um compromisso genuíno. Trabalhamos para fazer com que todas as pessoas Spreaders se sintam valorizadas, respeitadas e capacitadas para alcançar o pleno potencial. Reconhecemos que a verdadeira diversidade vai além de questões superficiais e abrange uma ampla gama de características, como gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, idade e habilidades.

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua desde 1932 no Brasil e faz parte do Grupo multinacional Roemmers, com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina.

No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos e cosméticos, atua em dois segmentos: medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1.500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história por meio de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

  • Experiência prévia em Inteligência Comercial, Inteligência de Mercado ou Planejamento Comercial, preferencialmente no setor farmacêutico.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel (uso modelagem de dados em tabela dinâmica) e intermediário em Power Point.
  • Experiência com bases de dados do mercado farmacêutico, como IQVIA (FMB/PMB, DDD, Close-Up, MDTR, Audits), Close-Up, Nielsen ou similares.

title: Partner Account Manager - Public Sector
description:
Overview

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role will join Samsara’s Global Partnerships team, which is responsible for building and activating our ecosystem of go-to-market partners across Insurance, co-sell, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Public Sector routes to market, and Fleet Management Companies.

You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

This is a great role for somebody looking to make an impact and influence the future of our Public Sector partnership strategy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop key relationships and build scalable programs with our Public Sector distribution and resale partners to drive net new pipeline and accelerate sales outcomes
  • Work with Sales and other cross-functional partners within Samsara to identify opportunities that our partners can accelerate
  • Build a scaled Public Sector channel motion (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Play a role in shaping our Public Sector partnerships strategic roadmap
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5 years of experience in Public Sector partnerships or sales
  • Experience with scaled Public Sector channel motions (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Experience building programs with a history of driving the Public Sector pipeline through partners
  • Kind and collaborative orientation, who is energized by working with a lot of different types of people from many teams
  • A builder mentality—you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves; no task is too big or small
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in B2B technology or within a B2B technology ecosystem
  • Experience working with Carahsoft
  • Experience with common Public Sector contract vehicles used to purchase IT/cloud and/or fleet management solutions

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. $78,926.75 — $132,650 USD

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Benefits

Full time employees receive a competitive total compensation package along with employee-led remote and flexible working, health benefits, and much, much more. Take a look at our Benefits site to learn more.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in Samsara domain. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Overview

Growth Marketer for UK DTC E-Commerce Brand - Purolabs. Location: Remote. Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK GMT (minimum 4 hours overlap). Contract Type: Independent contractor. Language: English only.

About Purolabs

The Role

We\'re looking for a proactive and data-driven Growth Marketer who lives and breathes performance marketing and customer acquisition. This is not a brand marketing role - the focus is entirely on direct response: driving measurable customer acquisition, optimising funnels, and scaling campaigns profitably. You\'ll own the full growth strategy, working hands-on with paid acquisition, conversion optimisation, and customer retention. You should be the kind of person who obsesses over unit economics, loves testing new approaches, and gets genuinely excited when you crack a winning strategy that scales.

What You\'ll Be Doing

  • Paid Acquisition & Campaign Management: Plan, execute, and optimise paid social campaigns across Meta and TikTok to hit ROAS and CAC targets
  • Develop systematic testing frameworks for audiences, creative angles, and landing pages
  • Scale winning campaigns while maintaining profitability and healthy unit economics
  • Monitor daily ad account performance and make data-driven optimisation decisions
  • Collaborate with creative team to provide performance feedback and strategic direction
  • Analytics & Performance Tracking: Own key growth metrics including CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, CPA, and contribution margin
  • Build and maintain dashboards to track funnel performance and identify bottlenecks
  • Conduct cohort analysis and customer lifetime value modelling
  • Review campaign data to understand what\'s working and communicate insights clearly to the team
  • Present weekly performance reports with actionable strategic recommendations
  • Conversion Rate Optimisation: Run structured A/B tests on landing pages, product pages, and checkout flow
  • Analyse user behaviour using Google Analytics, Heatmaps and tools like Triple Whale
  • Identify friction points in the customer journey and implement solutions
  • Optimise email flows and post-purchase sequences to increase retention and LTV
  • Systematise processes for repeatable, scalable growth
  • Growth Strategy & Channel Expansion: Develop quarterly growth roadmaps aligned with revenue and profitability targets
  • Test and scale new traffic sources including YouTube and emerging platforms
  • Conduct competitor analysis and market research to identify growth opportunities
  • Proactively flag issues, spot inconsistencies, and solve problems before they escalate
  • Think strategically about the big picture while maintaining attention to detail

Essential Experience

What We\'re Looking For

  • 2-3+ years of proven experience in direct response or growth marketing for DTC e-commerce brands
  • Strong track record of managing and scaling paid social campaigns profitably on Meta and TikTok
  • Deep understanding of direct response metrics and unit economics (CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, CPA, contribution margin)
  • Hands-on experience reviewing ad accounts and understanding campaign performance
  • Ability to provide clear feedback to creative teams based on data and performance insights
  • Experience working cross-functionally with creative teams, agencies, and performance specialists
  • Proven ability to run structured experiments and iterate based on results

Technical Requirements

  • Expert-level proficiency with ad platforms like Meta and TikTok
  • Experience with analytics tools like Triple Whale and Lifetimely
  • Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel/Google Sheets and data visualisation
  • Experience with Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and attribution
  • Familiarity with Shopify and e-commerce analytics platforms
  • Available during UK working hours (9am-5pm GMT) with minimum 4-hour overlap daily
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) - all application materials must be in English

Bonus Points

  • Experience with consumer consumables, supplements, skincare, or subscription-based products
  • Knowledge of email marketing platforms like Klaviyo and retention strategies
  • Familiarity with other emerging acquisition channels
  • Background in health, wellness, or supplements industry

Your Personality

  • Numbers-obsessed and data-driven - you make decisions based on metrics, not opinions
  • Highly detail-oriented with ability to spot incongruencies and think strategically
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they arise
  • Strong communicator who can translate data into clear, actionable insights
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments
  • Self-starter who takes ownership and drives results independently

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote with flexibility during UK hours
  • Competitive salary and paid time off (including UK bank holidays)
  • Real ownership over growth strategy and performance outcomes
  • Training opportunities and quarterly growth reviews
  • Work with a product that genuinely improves people\'s wellbeing
  • Join a fast-growing brand with proven product-market fit

How To Apply

Please submit your application via LinkedIn including:

  • Your CV (in English) highlighting your DTC/e-commerce experience with specific results achieved
  • A 2-minute video introduction telling us why you\'re excited about this role and what makes you the right fit

Important Requirements

  • This is a remote contractor position (not employment)
  • Applications welcome from all countries
  • Must be available during UK working hours (9am-5pm GMT) with a minimum 4-hour overlap
  • All materials (CV, case study, video) must be submitted in English

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to modernize the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds, with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users in need of assistance. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This role reports to the Director of IT.

The Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, and other channels. We are predominantly Mac-focused and you should be proficient at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment and will own the onboarding experience for all new employees as well as the retrieval process for departing employees. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, and more. You will work with Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.). You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (Google Workspace, Okta, etc.) and document solutions, create help articles, and automate routine tasks. You will manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues through to completion. You will balance help desk tickets with project work (agile practices, Jira, sprints) and align your objectives with team and company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta.
  • Experience with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills across all media; ability to convey ideas clearly and help non-technical users without loss of patience.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures.
  • A mindset to provide a magical experience for others and a security-conscious approach (PGP awareness).
  • Solid networking fundamentals and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching) and methodical OSI-model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams; strong organizational and task-management skills.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; prior use is helpful but certifications are not required.
  • Experience using GAM and command-line efficiencies.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress, adaptability and resilience; comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in handling confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have previously worked in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities as a leading digital asset company.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting from your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company through shared equity.
  • Remote work option up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A role with purpose and the removal of barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Inclusive, diverse, equal opportunity employment; confidentiality in accommodation requests.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is truly global, spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote-first environment. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. No unsolicited resumes accepted.

description:

Creative Strategist UK E-Commerce Brand

Location: Remote

Contract Type: Independent contractor

Language: English only

About Purolabs

Purolabs is a fast-growing DTC supplements brand based in the UK with over 350,000 happy customers. We create clean, science-backed supplements that actually work – no fillers, no nasties, just real results. Featured in Vogue, Women’s Health, and Evening Standard, our UK-made products are trusted by health‑conscious people who refuse to compromise on quality.

The Role

We’re looking for a Creative Strategist who lives and breathes performance marketing and creative. You’re equal parts strategic thinker and compelling copywriter – someone who owns the creative vision behind our paid social campaigns while writing the scripts, briefs, and copy that bring them to life. It’s about understanding customer pain points, crafting messages that resonate, and driving real growth through performance‑focused creative that converts. You should obsess over hook rates, study competitor ads for fun, and get genuinely excited when you crack a winning angle.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop end‑to‑end creative strategies aligned with customer acquisition targets
  • Conduct competitor analysis and trend research to keep our creative cutting‑edge
  • Map out creative testing roadmaps and campaign calendars
  • Write compelling direct‑response copy, UGC scripts, and ad copy for Meta and TikTok
  • Craft hooks, CTAs, and messaging that convert browsers into buyers
  • Develop copy for landing pages, email campaigns, and marketing materials
  • Translate complex supplement science into clear, benefit‑driven messaging
  • Create detailed creative briefs for designers and video editors
  • Collaborate with graphic designers and marketing team
  • Manage the creative production pipeline from ideation to launch
  • Analyse creative performance metrics including CTR, CPA, hook rate, conversion rate, and ROAS
  • Implement A/B testing and rapid iteration based on data insights
  • Present weekly performance reports with actionable recommendations

Essential Experience

  • 2+ years of proven experience in creative strategy and copywriting for DTC brands
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating successful paid social campaigns with measurable results
  • Experience writing scripts for UGC creators, Meta ads, and TikTok ads
  • Deep understanding of marketing psychology, emotional triggers, and conversion copywriting
  • Data‑driven mindset with ability to turn metrics into actionable creative insights
  • Exceptional communication skills and obsessive attention to detail
  • Expert‑level copywriting for performance marketing
  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager
  • Available during UK working hours (9am‑5pm GMT) with minimum 4‑hour overlap daily
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) – all application materials must be in English

Bonus Points

  • Experience with competitor research tools (Motion, Foreplay, MagicBrief)
  • Background in health, wellness, or supplements industry
  • Understanding of ASA regulations and health claims compliance
  • Experience directing on‑camera talent or creators

Your Personality

  • You live and breathe performance marketing – truly obsessed with what makes ads work
  • Passionate about creative strategy and social trends
  • Excellent communicator who values clarity and over‑communication
  • Solutions‑oriented with high emotional intelligence
  • Detail‑oriented and triple‑checks everything
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and thrives in fast‑paced environments

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote with flexibility during UK hours
  • Competitive salary and paid time off (including UK bank holidays)
  • Real ownership over creative strategy and direction
  • Training opportunities and quarterly growth reviews
  • Work on campaigns that genuinely improve people’s wellbeing
  • Join a fast‑growing brand with proven product‑market fit and loyal customers

How to Apply

Please submit your application via LinkedIn including:

  • Your CV (in English) highlighting your DTC/e‑commerce experience
  • A link to your portfolio or examples of your creative strategy work
  • A 2‑minute video introduction telling us why you’re excited about this role and what makes you the right fit

Important Requirements

  • Remote contractor position – not employment
  • Applications welcome from all countries
  • Must be available during UK working hours (9am‑5pm GMT) with minimum 4‑hour overlap
  • All materials (CV, portfolio, video) must be submitted in English
  • Applications without both a portfolio and video will not be considered

title: Senior Hardware Design Engineer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient Electronics Design Engineer to lead the development of advanced printed circuit boards (PCBs) for next‑generation wireline tools at Halliburton Technology Center Brazil (HTCB). This role involves end‑to‑end responsibility for designing, simulating, testing, and integrating complex electronic systems tailored for extreme environments in the oil & gas industry. The engineer will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams including physicists, electrical, mechanical, and systems engineers in Brazil, as well as global development teams in the United States and Singapore, ensuring seamless integration and innovation across international platforms.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a closely related field.
  • Advanced degrees (M.Sc. or Ph.D.) in relevant disciplines are highly desirable and will be considered favorably.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience in embedded hardware development for harsh environments (e.g., oil & gas, aerospace, defense), including system‑level modeling, simulation, and validation.
  • Expertise in digital and analog circuit design, including:
    • Microcontrollers, DSPs, FPGAs
    • Signal conditioning, ADC/DAC systems
    • Memory architecture and control
    • Communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, etc.)
  • Strong proficiency in high‑speed PCB design, including:
    • Impedance control
    • Signal integrity analysis
    • EMI/EMC mitigation strategies
  • Hands‑on experience with PCB CAD tools (e.g., PADS, Altium Designer).
  • Skilled in circuit simulation tools (e.g., LTspice, PSpice).
  • Familiarity with lab instrumentation such as oscilloscopes, spectrum/network analyzers, electronic loads, and impedance analyzers.
  • Experience in automated test and measurement systems, including programming in LabVIEW and/or MATLAB for data acquisition and control.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced R&D environment.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, innovation mindset, and ownership of technical deliverables.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Preferred Attributes

  • Prior experience in research and development (R&D) environments.
  • Exposure to multi‑disciplinary engineering teams and international collaboration.
  • Familiarity with reliability testing, thermal analysis, and design for manufacturability (DFM).

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient Electronics Design Engineer to lead the development of advanced printed circuit boards (PCBs) for next-generation wireline tools at Halliburton Technology Center Brazil (HTCB) .   • Strong problem-solving skills, innovation mindset, and ownership of technical deliverables.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Preferred Attributes

  • Prior experience in research and development (R&D) environments.
  • Exposure to multi-disciplinary engineering teams and international collaboration.

title: Data Engineer
description:
A Avra é uma plataforma de inteligência de dados deep tech, que traduz a complexidade das pequenas e médias empresas em decisões estratégicas para grandes corporações.

Desenvolvemos nossos próprios modelos fundamentais do zero — sem depender de soluções de terceiros — para entregar insights inovadores que impulsionam grandes bancos e fintechs em toda a América Latina.

Fundada em 2024 por Bruno Alano (ex-OpenAI) e Viviane Meister , a Avra reúne talentos, com o propósito de fazer IA de verdade e gerar impacto real.

Sobre a Vaga

Na Avra, estamos construindo nossa plataforma de dados do zero — uma base confiável e escalável que sustenta nossos produtos e os modelos de IA que desenvolvemos.

Como Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior , você será peça-chave na concepção, evolução e governança dessa infraestrutura, garantindo que os dados fluam de forma segura, rastreável e de alta qualidade entre sistemas e times.

Nosso desafio vai muito além de ingestão e transformação: estamos criando um ecossistema de dados robusto, que atende múltiplos consumidores — de times de produto a research — cada um com diferentes níveis de performance, experimentação e governança.

Você vai ajudar a tomar decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo, sem perder o foco em entregar soluções táticas que geram valor imediato.

Responsabilidades

  • Arquitetura Lakehouse: Projetar e gerenciar estruturas escaláveis baseadas em Apache Iceberg nos ambientes AWS e GCP, com versionamento, time travel e alto desempenho analítico.
  • Engenharia de Pipelines: Construir e manter pipelines batch e streaming usando Spark, Ray e Dagster.
  • Governança de Dados: Definir e aplicar padrões de qualidade, segurança, linhagem e compliance, assegurando confiabilidade e contexto em todo o ciclo de vida dos dados.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Utilizar Terraform e CI/CD para versionar e implantar toda a stack de dados — de permissões e buckets a orquestrações e componentes de computação.
  • Arquitetura e Data Warehouse: Projetar arquiteturas de dados e DW multi-cloud (AWS e GCP), garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e otimização de custo.
  • Gestão de Grafos: Manter e evoluir o grafo heterogêneo de relacionamentos que alimenta nossos modelos de IA.
  • Colaboração Técnica: Trabalhar junto a engenheiros, cientistas de dados e stakeholders técnicos para alinhar a estratégia de dados às metas da Avra.

Você se destaca se...

  • Tem domínio em Python e Spark e gosta de resolver problemas complexos em grande escala.
  • Já construiu ou manteve arquiteturas lakehouse com Apache Iceberg ou Delta Lake.
  • Tem experiência com Dagster (ou ferramentas equivalentes) para orquestração de pipelines.

  • Já implementou práticas sólidas de governança, observabilidade e linhagem de dados.
  • Possui experiência com arquitetura de dados e Data Warehouses modernos, equilibrando performance e custo.
  • É uma pessoa proativa, analítica e com mentalidade de produto, que se preocupa em entregar dados úteis, acessíveis e confiáveis.
  • Gosta de trabalhar em um ambiente de inovação, colaboração e velocidade, típico de startups deep tech.

Requisitos

  • Domínios Técnicos: Modelagem de dados, pipelines de ETL, governança, linhagem e processamento em tempo real.

When you work at Fetch, you play a vital role in a platform that drives brand loyalty and creates lifelong consumers with the power of Fetch points. User and partner success are at the heart of everything we do, and we extend that same commitment to our employees.

At Fetch, we value curiosity, adaptability, and the confidence to explore new tools, especially AI, to drive smarter, faster work. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should be ready to learn quickly and think critically. We welcome learners who move fast, challenge the status quo, and shape what’s next, with us. Ranked as one of America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes for two years in a row, Fetch fosters a people-first culture rooted in trust, accountability, and innovation. We encourage our employees to challenge ideas, think bigger, and always bring the fun to Fetch.

Fetch is an equal employment opportunity employer.

About the Role

  • The Sr. Partner Director will report directly to the VP, Industry Lead and will be responsible for building new relationships with an existing strategic CPG client in the Enterprise Household Essentials vertical.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US offices or remotely in the United States, with a preference for candidates located in CST or EST.

Role Responsibilities

  • Existing relevant vertical expertise in enterprisehousehold essentials accounts with experience targeting relevant stakeholders such as senior-level marketing, media, and executive contacts.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with full-funnel sales cycles: From prospecting and discovery to closing and renewal

  • Understanding of shopper marketing, loyalty programs, or consumer engagement strategies.
  • Knowledge of CPG buying cycles and retailer marketing dynamics
  • Awareness of digital KPIs: Impressions, CTR, ROAS, brand lift, etc.

  • At Fetch, we offer competitive compensation packages to the exceptional folks we hire. The base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $204,000. The on-target earnings range for this position is $306,250 - $357,000 . This does not include accelerators or sales plan incentive funds, which employees may also be eligible for. We also offer all employees equity in Fetch, so that everyone can benefit from Fetch’s growth. Discover our benefits and how our employees live rewarded at

title: Database Administrator - SQL Server | Remote
description:
Overview

Como Administrador(a) de Banco de Dados Sênior (DBA), com especialidade em SQL Server, você gerenciará e manterá o sistema de banco de dados SQL Server, garantindo a integridade dos dados, performance e segurança. Lidera iniciativas complexas, orienta DBAs mais juniores e atua como referência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Instalar, configurar e manter instâncias e bancos de dados SQL Server (versões 2012 a 2022).
  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Recovery (Full, Differential, Transaction log, Point-in-time recovery).
  • Implementar, gerenciar e solucionar problemas em soluções de Alta Disponibilidade (HA) & Disaster Recovery (DR), como Always On Availability Groups e Replicação Transacional.
  • Gerenciar a segurança do banco de dados, incluindo usuários, roles, permissões, e implementar recursos como Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Data Masking e Row-Level Security.
  • Configurar e gerenciar a Auditoria do SQL Server para fins de segurança e conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Realizar tuning e otimização de performance de queries complexas, analisando planos de execução, utilizando Query Store e definindo estratégias de indexação.
  • Gerenciar e manter índices (Clustered, Non-Clustered, Columnstore) e estatísticas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de diagnóstico como SQL Profiler, Extended Events e DMVs para identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance.
  • Realizar tuning de I/O, CPU e Memória para otimizar a performance do SQL Server.
  • Otimizar a configuração e uso do TempDB.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de concorrência, como Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.
  • Desenvolver T-SQL complexo, incluindo stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, CTEs, Dynamic SQL e manipulação de XML/JSON.
  • Desenvolver scripts em PowerShell para automação de tarefas administrativas e de manutenção.
  • Criar, gerenciar e otimizar Jobs complexos no SQL Server Agent.
  • Administrar ambientes de banco de dados na nuvem (Azure SQL Database, SQL Server em VMs - IaaS, Managed Instances - PaaS) e híbridos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Disaster Recovery na nuvem.
  • Utilizar Azure Data Factory para fluxos de integração de dados.
  • Desenvolver, implantar e manter pacotes SSIS para migração e transformação de dados (ETL).
  • Implementar e gerenciar Change Data Capture (CDC) e Change Tracking.
  • Implementar monitoramento proativo da saúde dos bancos de dados e health checks.
  • Utilizar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento de terceiros (ex: Redgate, DataDog SentryOne, SQL Monitor).
  • Desenvolver scripts para automação de tarefas de manutenção e criação de alertas.
  • Configurar, gerenciar e analisar logs de auditoria e monitoramento de atividades no SQL Server.
  • Implementar e gerenciar a automação de deployments de banco de dados (ex: Flyway, Liquibase, Redgate).
  • Integrar o gerenciamento de código de banco de dados com sistemas de controle de versão (Git, Azure DevOps, SVN).
  • Integrar e manter deployments de banco de dados em pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas e projetos de banco de dados.
  • Orientar DBAs de níveis júnior e pleno.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre o ambiente de banco de dados.

Requisitos básicos

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência consolidada (8+ anos) em administração de banco de dados, com especialidade em SQL Server.
  • Profundo conhecimento em instalação, configuração e manutenção do SQL Server (versões 2012, 2014, 2016, 2019, 2022).
  • Experiência prática com estratégias de Backup e Recovery
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança SQL Server
  • Experiência com requisitos de conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Domínio de Performance Tuning
  • Experiência com ferramentas de diagnóstico de performance: SQL Profiler, Extended Events, DMVs.
  • Conhecimento em tuning de I/O, CPU, Memória e otimização de TempDB.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting de Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento T-SQL complexo
  • Experiência com ambientes de banco de dados em nuvem
  • Conhecimento em Data Warehousing e integração com ferramentas de BI
  • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD (Git, Azure DevOps, SVN).

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a Manager, Paid Search - a performance-driven marketer with a strong mastery of paid search advertising systems, the evolving AI search environment, and a deep understanding of the AI ecosystem and emerging ad platforms. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms, particularly Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI (some of these platforms don’t have ad services yet). Though primarily focused on Google, the role will require expertise and campaign deployment on other paid search based platforms as well, and a willingness to try new platforms as AI search product evolve.

Perfect candidates will be obsessed with Paid Search Advertising, experts at search buying behavior, with a clear demonstrated history of selling products through paid search advertising, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and breath ads manager, you are curious about the emerging AI advertising ecosystem, and performance marketing at large. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning creative strategy, campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, creator, brand and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands‑on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Brazil, and Mexico

What you’ll do:

  • Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies exclusively focused on Paid Search to increase brand visibility and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.

  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.

  • Obsession with the paid search advertising action, bid system, and market dynamics to best convert customers at the lowest possible cost for the brand.

  • Keen to develop innovative paid search strategies that blend traditional search, YouTube, and emerging AI search.

  • Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.

  • Manage between 6-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Google, YouTube, Bing, and the emerging AI sSearch Platforms (Koah, Kontext) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $20,000 - $3M.

  • Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, and AI to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month-over-month and solve for attribution.

  • Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM.

  • Understand industry-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e-commerce marketing funnel.

  • Implement real-time, proactive, and reactionary ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up-or-down trends happening on ads platforms (you will be in ad platforms daily).

  • Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.

  • Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.

  • Understand full-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new customer acquisition is healthy within the broader e-commerce equation.

  • Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy.

  • Willingness and openness to learn and understand e-commerce P&Ls with a comfortability engaging with financial metrics.

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • Mastery of the e-commerce marketing funnel —> offer to ad to landing page to conversion.

  • 7+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience within Paid Search, Google in specific (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).

  • 5+ years minimum managing paid search advertising for growing clients in the consumer space spending over $400k+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.

  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short form video creative.

  • Expertise in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert.

  • Background in data-derived decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results.

  • Experience with all core e-commerce revenue drivers, reporting on metrics that actually matter (CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, CPM).

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well-being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Generous Quarterly Bonuses: Your productivity directly translates to your compensation. We offer a competitive quarterly bonus structure that is both substantial and customized to your role, ensuring your hard work is consistently and generously rewarded.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Overview

Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes. Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo. Estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes. Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão: mapear as necessidades do cliente para oferecer soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da empresa, buscando oportunidades em novas áreas, aumentar presença em grupos econômicos.
  • Negociar e fechar contratos: atuar diretamente nas negociações de expansão de contratos.
  • Parceria interna: colaborar com equipes de Customer Success, Produto e Marketing para entregar valor contínuo e alinhar estratégias.
  • Análise de dados e métricas: monitorar o desempenho das contas, como Net Revenue Retention (NRR), churn e expansão, para orientar ações estratégicas.
  • Gestão de pipeline: manter um pipeline atualizado com foco em oportunidades de expansão.
  • Acompanhar portfólio de clientes: desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com decisores e influenciadores das contas existentes.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em vendas, em posições de Account Executive, Farmer ou similar, preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia B2B.
  • Experiência com negociações complexas com grandes contas, gestão e crescimento de contas Enterprise ou KA.

About InPlanet


InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany, Brazil and the US with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.


Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.


Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symoo illustrates our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.


We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.


You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us.


Check out our Culture page here.


Key Responsibilities



  • Providing accurate quantitative information for drawing up contracts with partner farmers, and logistical solutions to optimize the delivery of remineralizer.

  • Manage and process primary and secondary spatial data to produce dynamic and static maps and reports of high technical quality that communicate our operations and results effectively to various target audiences.

  • Undertaking multi-criteria analysis to guide decision-making in different stages of ERW project implementation.

  • Provide data to guide field campaigns, as well as constantly updating monitoring metrics from the data collected from sampling, transport and spreading.

  • Produce detailed technical documentation of the processes and methodologies used, supporting the project reporting and our carbon team by contributing to our project design documents (PDDs).

  • Maximizing the partner farmer's benefits through precision agriculture solutions that promote more efficient use of inputs and increased agricultural productivity, mainly through the mapping of physical and chemical soil properties.


Living Our Values


At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.



  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes

  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency

  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change


You can be a Rock-Star if you have


Core Skills & Experience



  • Academic background in areas related to Geosciences, Agricultural Sciences and the Environment, such as Geography, Cartographic Engineering, Agronomic Engineering, Forestry Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Management, Environmental Sciences, etc.

  • Core proficiency in QGIS.

  • Experience in an object-oriented programming language such as R and/or Python.

  • Basic understanding of Spatial SQL and DBMS like PostgreSQL & PostGIS.

  • Experience with Digital Image Processing techniques applied to optical and elevation data.

  • Data wrangling skills and familiarity with processing large datasets are a plus.

  • Experience with Spatial Sampling and Geostatistics is a plus.

  • Willingness to keep up‑to‑date and share knowledge about the latest geotechnologies trends, tools, and methods, especially related to the development of Free and Open Source Software for Geospatial (FOSS4G).

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  • Intrinsic motivation for personal and professional improvement.

  • High dedication, precision and love for detail.

  • Passion for sustainability, climate change mitigation, and technology‑driven solutions for positive impact.

  • Startup Drive: ability and excitement to work in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven, value‑driven environment.


Key Qualities



  • Strong communication skills, both in interpreting and presenting map data.

  • Proactive problem-solver with a desire for continuous learning and development.

  • Deep appreciation for nature and alignment with our purpose‑driven mission.


Bonus Points (but not essential)



  • A portfolio showcasing map quality and complexity.

  • Experience in soil sciences or related environmental fields.


Benefits



  • Competitive Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly

  • Home Office Budget

  • Personal development budget

  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance

  • 40 days annual leave

  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.

  • Offsites in Brazil yay!

  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4-hour time zones).


About the Role


We are seeking a passionate GIS Assistant to join our team, focusing on cartography, spatial analysis, and enhanced rock weathering projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in geoprocessing, remote sensing, and environmental management. This role is perfect for someone who loves nature, is aligned with our mission, and is eager to grow and stay updated with the latest geotechnology trends. If you're passionate about nature, GIS technologies, and environmental impact, we'd love to hear from you!


Core working relationships: You will report directly to Igor, the GIS Modeller. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with field technicians and project managers to ensure the successful integration of GIS data across various projects. Additionally, you will support the Science and Carbon teams by providing spatial data analysis and insights essential for our Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) operations.


InPlanet Compensation Philosophy


At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)

  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling

To hear about updates on future opportunities, please follow us on LinkedIn. To keep up with InPlanet market updates, subscribe to our Newsletter.


How to Apply

Focusing on offshore and onshore logistics operations, this position will plan, coordinate, and execute the movement of materials, equipment, and personnel.   • Manage and oversee shorebase contracts, monitoring performance and ensuring service quality and compliance.
  • Lead the logistics team and all logistics activities, driving efficiency, cost optimization, and alignment with project and operational needs.

description:
Join to apply for the Ux Designer role at Memory Ware

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades.

We're looking for a UX Designer who's excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative, especially in games inspired by classic and modern JRPGs. As a UX Designer on our team, you'll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat and exploration.

We're not just looking for someone to make interfaces clean and usable, we want someone who can envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience.

You’ll collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player-first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game genre-aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player-first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain your reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing for console or controller-first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

To Apply:

Send your e‑mail to "******" with a subject like "UX Designer – Your Name". Include your resume, portfolio, and any details about yourself that you'd like to share.

About Memory Ware: Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, born on **** to sustainably create video games designed with a player‑first philosophy, crafting compelling stories and experiences that create lasting, core memories for players. We are a self‑funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project. title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.

title: Ux Designer
description:
Overview

Ux Designer role at Memory Ware. Memory Ware is a fully remote studio focused on player-first experiences in games, with a JRPG-inspired design ethos.

We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a UX Designer who is excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative. You’ll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat and exploration. You should be able to envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience. You will collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

Responsibilities

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) are intuitive, satisfying, and player-first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the gameplay loop and propose smart, game-genre-aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure visual and technical execution supports usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low-fidelity prototypes.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player-first mindset with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing for console or controller-first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy and ability to engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

To Apply

Email your resume and portfolio; include any details about yourself you’d like to share. Send your email to the address provided with a subject like "UX Designer- Your Name".

About Memory Ware

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, focused on sustainably creating video games with a player-first philosophy, crafting stories and experiences that create lasting memories for players. We are a self-funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project. If you’re eager to help create a healthy and fun work environment alongside a highly experienced team, you’ll feel right at home with us.

Location & Type

Overview

HealthLinkNow, a division of Universal Health Services, Inc. (UHS), is actively seeking an experienced and compassionate Licensed Telehealth Therapist to join our expanding team of behavioral health professionals. This fully remote, flexible role is designed for clinicians who value meaningful work, professional growth, and a healthy work–life balance. You’ll deliver high‑quality, evidence‑based care from the comfort of your home while being part of a collaborative clinical team that values innovation, connection, and purpose. We’re looking for a dynamic clinician eager to grow into leadership, contribute to service development, and participate in special initiatives that enhance access, quality, and innovation in behavioral health.

About HealthLinkNow

HealthLinkNow (HLN) is a nationally recognized leader in telebehavioral health and the first telehealth company to earn Joint Commission accreditation. As part of Universal Health Services (UHS) – one of the nation’s largest and most respected healthcare organizations – we’re committed to delivering accessible, outcome‑driven mental health care across the country. With a 98% patient satisfaction rate, HLN’s innovative digital platform simplifies clinical workflows so you can focus on what matters most: your patients, your practice, and your growth.

Position Summary

As a Lead Telehealth Therapist, you will:

  • Deliver individual, family, and group therapy sessions through a secure telehealth platform.
  • Facilitate Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) groups in collaboration with partner hospitals.
  • Oversee and coordinate a variety of therapeutic services, supporting quality improvement and consistency across programs.
  • Engage in special initiatives that promote innovation, clinical excellence, and expansion of telehealth programs nationwide.
  • Provide clinical leadership and mentorship while shaping program development and service delivery.
  • Work autonomously yet collaboratively within a supportive, multidisciplinary team.
  • Enjoy flexible scheduling, diverse assignments, and the stability of working with a mission‑driven organization that values both professional excellence and personal well‑being.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide individual and group psychotherapy for clients with mental health and co‑occurring substance use disorders.
  • Facilitate and document IOP groups via telehealth.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments and develop individualized treatment plans.
  • Monitor and document progress using HLN’s EMR system.
  • Collaborate with psychiatrists and interdisciplinary teams to coordinate care.
  • Lead monthly clinical team meetings and contribute to provider evaluations.
  • Offer clinical oversight and mentorship as directed by leadership.
  • Participate in ongoing supervision, licensure support, and cross‑program initiatives.
  • Uphold ethical standards, organizational policies, and service excellence.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $90,000 – $93,000 (W‑2)
  • Sign‑On Bonus: $5,000 after 90 days (with 2‑year commitment)
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and more
  • Work Environment: 100% remote — flexible scheduling with secure internet connection required
  • Team Support: Weekly peer supervision, Clinical Director guidance, and collaborative culture
  • Low Administrative Burden: Focus on client care — not paperwork
  • Work–Life Balance: Flexibility, autonomy, and strong organizational support
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities to lead initiatives, expand licensure, and shape program delivery

Why Join HealthLinkNow?

  • Be part of a mission‑driven, inclusive team expanding access to behavioral health services nationwide.
  • Enjoy career growth through leadership, training, and cross‑functional initiatives.
  • Benefit from flexible schedules, full benefits, and diverse assignments that keep your work engaging and meaningful.
  • Backed by Universal Health Services (UHS) — a Fortune 500 company with over 90,000 employees across 37 states and abroad.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, tech‑forward environment that supports your professional ambitions and personal well‑being.

Vision | Mission | Goals

Vision: To be the telehealth partner of choice for behavioral health.
Mission: To deliver outcome‑driven virtual behavioral healthcare that inspires hope and advocates for our patients and employees.
Goals: Clinical Excellence | Engaged Workforce | Customer Centricity

Qualifications

  • Active California clinical license (LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, or LMHC).
  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of clinical experience providing individual, family, and/or group therapy.
  • Demonstrated leadership potential or experience overseeing services or initiatives.
  • Proficient with telehealth platforms and EMRs.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.
  • Commitment to work–life balance, career growth, and patient‑centered care.
